steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: WHO Definition: The World Health Organisation defines health as "a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity." | Important: Health is NOT just the absence of illness. A person can be free from disease but still have poor mental or social health. True health requires well-being in all three areas. | Definition: Fitness is "the ability to meet the demands of the environment" or "the ability to meet the demands of a physical task." It refers to how well the body can cope with the physical challenges it faces. | Key Concept: Health and fitness are related but they are NOT the same thing. A person can be fit but not healthy, or healthy but not fit. Being fit can contribute to good health, but it does not guarantee it.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: State the WHO definition of health. | Define fitness. | Explain how a person can be fit but not healthy, giving a specific example.
